task_definition.title: RBD-α: MassProperties + JointForce + MotionTrajectory structure defs in stdlib (PSD inertia validation)
task_definition.description:
Author the Phase-1 foundation structure_defs for rigid-body dynamics in a NEW stdlib module crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/dynamics.ri:

- `MassProperties { mass: Mass, com: Point3, inertia: Tensor3x3, origin: Frame3 }` per PRD §4.1. Tensor3x3 = symmetric 3×3 inertia tensor stored as [[Real;3];3] Matrix at value level.
- `JointForce { joint_id: BodyId, value: JointForceValue }` per PRD §4.2; JointForceValue is a tagged union mirroring JointValue: ScalarForce(Real) prismatic, ScalarTorque(Real) revolute/coupling, CylForce([Real;2]), PlanarForce([Real;3]), SphereForce([Real;3]), ZeroForce (fixed).
- `TrajectorySample { t: Time, values: List<JointValue>, vels: List<JointValue>, accels: List<JointValue> }` and `MotionTrajectory { mechanism: Mechanism, samples: List<TrajectorySample> }` per PRD §4.3.

Ctor constraint validation (structure_def constraint block): mass >= 0 (zero allowed for massless intermediate links; warn on use); inertia symmetric PSD — eigenvalue check at MassProperties(...) ctor time, violation emits E_DynamicsInertiaNotPSD per PRD §4.1.

PRD: docs/prds/v0_3/rigid-body-dynamics.md task α

User-observable signal: compile test asserts the structure_defs resolve to expected templates; ctor MassProperties(mass: ..., inertia: non_psd_matrix, ...) emits E_DynamicsInertiaNotPSD (ctor returns Undef).
Consumer: β (body_mass_props builds MassProperties), η (inverse_dynamics returns List<JointForce>), δ/ε (MotionTrajectory/TrajectorySample consumers) — intra-batch.
Crates touched: crates/reify-compiler/stdlib/dynamics.ri (NEW), reify-compiler constraint validation.

Cross-PRD prereq (report-only, not wired by this batch): SIR-α task 3540 (Value::StructureInstance ctor lowering) — DONE/merged 2026-05-16, so this prereq is already satisfied.
